title: Devlog Entry
description: Schema for a single entry in .state/devlog.jsonl. Each line of devlog.jsonl is a JSON object matching this schema. Append-only; one record per step/action outcome.

phase.description: Phase number, or null for phase-less entries (refine-tier work; D-refine-8).

step.description: Step number, or null for phase-level entries (e.g., close action with no specific step).

action.description: Which action produced this entry. 'tests' = phase-level acceptance-suite authoring (Build only, D-tests-*); 'probe' = dependency probe result (conditional section in plan); 'integration_check' = cross-module integration verification (conditional section in close); 'refine' = ad-hoc refine-tier work (sub-phase, phase/step null; D-refine-8).

outcome.description: Result of the action. 'complete' = done, 'partial' = some work, 'blocked' = waiting on input, 'escalate' = needs human, 'failed' = error.

summary.description: Short narrative of what happened. 1-3 sentences.

contracts.description: ARCH_*.md files modified by this entry's work. Empty array if none.

kind.description: Refine kind (D-refine-8), mirroring followups.json. Only set on 'refine' entries.

iteration.description: Which iteration a null-step entry belongs to (Refine-regime or refine-tier). Folds in FU-9 (D-refine-8).
